title: All 14 Webots integration tests passed
summary: This commit adds LLM-assisted CI report diagnostics. All 14 scenarios (3 builtin, 7 cap, 4 flow) passed with 100% rate. The pipeline exercised camera/lidar snapshots, SLAM map saving, memory roundtrip, speech synthesis, voiceprint listing, exploration with timeout/cancel, fault recovery, object navigation, and patrol observe. No regressions detected.
pr_changes: Adds LLM-assisted report diagnostics for CI
Introduces testing infrastructure (scenarios, report generation, fake VLM)
Adds system components: atlas, executor, pilot, liaison, scene, scribe
Adds primitives: camera, chassis, lidar, audio
Adds tools: rbnx CLI, codegen, robonix-api
Adds Webots simulation environment with Tiago robot
Adds CI workflows for testing, bot, docs check, issue/PR triage
test_result: 14/14 scenarios passed: builtin (fault_recovery_builtin, file_roundtrip, run_command), cap (camera_snapshot, explore_smoke, lidar_snapshot, mapping_save, memory_roundtrip, scene_object_fixture, speech_speak, voiceprint_list), flow (fault_recovery, object_navigation, patrol_observe). All leaf calls succeeded as expected, including intentional failures (missing file, invalid args, explore timeout) that were correctly handled.
